items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refuse modified main-checkout scripts**

When the main checkout has an unstaged replacement for any invoked repository script, this verifies only that `HEAD` equals `origin/main`; it never verifies that the working-tree copies are tracked and unchanged. The chain will therefore execute locally modified `sandbox-scan.sh`, `local-review.sh`, `pr-feedback.py`, or audit tooling with the orchestrator's credentials, and the new tests actually rely on untracked script stubs so they do not cover this boundary. Validate each executable against `HEAD` before running it, and add the missing main-worktree-content control to the threat table.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/9f1cee1c1c0ef6e84ba8125f95b197ce3333b4ac/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recheck origin/main after the waits**

When `origin/main` advances after this ancestry check—for example during the required-check or 15-minute Bot wait—the chain never fetches or checks the base again and proceeds through the local review and audit using the now-behind head. The threat table marks “the base moving under the PR while the chain runs” closed, but its cited test advances main before invocation rather than after this check, so it does not close this race; refetch and restart before the review/audit boundary, or classify and control the residual race explicitly.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/9f1cee1c1c0ef6e84ba8125f95b197ce3333b4ac/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Redact external disposition paths from the log**

When the documented optional TSV is supplied from `/tmp`, `$HOME`, or another location outside the checkout, `step` records this argument verbatim because its path scrubbing only handles the `main` prefix. That puts a local-only absolute path into the repo-local chain evidence despite the script's guarantee that logs contain repository paths only; either require the TSV to be under `main` or redact/render this argument before logging.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L72-L72](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/9f1cee1c1c0ef6e84ba8125f95b197ce3333b4ac/AGENTS.md#L72-L72)
